Justin Freres is a senior software engineer and former K2-certified support specialist with experience across enterprise architecture, full-stack web development, networking and infrastructure, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central AL extensions, CI/CD, cybersecurity, SharePoint, and production support. His background also includes data recovery, backup-and-recovery systems, telecommunications, CompTIA A+ certification, Microsoft web and app-development credentials, five-plus years of Odoo development and support, K2 Five: Core certification, and a cybersecurity master’s degree. He coauthored an IEEE CSCI 2020 conference paper on relevance graphs in longitudinal text mining and contributed to the NASA–Missouri Space Grant Consortium AIDE graduate project, which applied AI to microstructural-defect identification.
